items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: He went to Hawaii with us right after the war in '46

ctx.x: How about Barney Kessel? When did he work with you?

Oh, Barney, I first got mixed up with Barney out here in Hollywood. He went to Hawaii with us right after the war in '46, and he played -- we did dates around up and down the coast here and everything. He was in the band.
Tell me about playing the Apollo. You're listed as the first[white] [inaudible] to play the Apollo theater in New York.
